name: Analyse Impulse Response
description: Analyse impulse response (IR) and return acoustic parameters such as EDT, T20, C50, etc., and its time and frequency responses for Plot 2D. STI and G need pyrato >= 1.0: on Rhino 8 they are computed in the worker, and left out without one.

inputParameters.name: time_scale
inputParameters.description: Scale of the time output: db (default), the level in dB re the peak, floored 100 dB below it, or linear, the amplitude. A value list is added when it is not connected.

outputParameters.name: params
outputParameters.description: List of acoustic parameters ('EDT', 'T20', 'T30', 'C50', 'C80', 'D50', 'DRR', 'Ts', and with a worker 'STI', with its modulation transfer index per band, and 'G').

outputParameters.name: time
outputParameters.description: The impulse response against time, for Plot 2D or a panel: the W channel of an ambisonic response, both ears (left, right) of a binaural one. It ends with the decay, 5 % after the Schroeder curve falls 100 dB (db) or 60 dB (linear); the parameters and the frequency output use the whole response.

outputParameters.name: frequency
outputParameters.description: The frequency response, 1/3-octave smoothed, 20 Hz to 20 kHz in dB re the peak, for Plot 2D or a panel: the W channel of an ambisonic response, both ears (left, right) of a binaural one.
